instructions:
Web access.
- web_fetch: Fetch a URL as clean markdown (auto bot-wall bypass, PDF, JS render)
- web_search: Web search : keyless aggregation or optional configured providers
- web_crawl: Crawl a site into markdown (sitemap-aware, focus-ranked, resumable)
- web_screenshot: Open a URL in a real browser, return the page as PNG

MCP results contain content blocks. Join text blocks: leading [meta] JSON, then source evidence. Some bridges flatten them to a string. Parse the first line for state; the rest is source text. Failures return ok:false + code + next_action; protocol faults throw.
